step.name: Step 1
step.text: Getting new cabinets can really transform your kitchen, but it's not just about picking them out—installation is key! Here's a general timeline of what to expect for a smooth process:

step.name: Step 2
step.text: Phase 1: Planning and Preparation. This is where you and your contractor finalize all the measurements and cabinet selections. It's crucial to confirm wall and floor conditions, making sure everything is ready for the new cabinets. We also talk about where appliances will go and how they'll integrate with the cabinets, avoiding surprises later on. This phase sets the stage for everything else, making sure we're all on the same page regarding the layout and specific needs like custom fillers or pantry inserts.

step.name: Step 3
step.text: Phase 2: Initial Cabinet Placement. Once the space is prepped, we start setting the base cabinets. This involves carefully marking locations and ensuring everything is perfectly level and plumb. It’s super important for the long-term stability and function of your cabinets. Then we move on to the upper cabinets, making sure they’re aligned correctly with the bases and securely fastened to the wall.

step.name: Step 4
step.text: Phase 3: Fine-Tuning and Finishing. After the main boxes are in, we focus on fitting any fillers or panels needed to create a seamless look. Then comes the critical step of aligning all the doors and drawers so they open and close smoothly. Finally, we install all the hardware – pulls, knobs, and any specialty inserts or organizers. This phase is all about the details that make your cabinets not just look good, but work beautifully every single day. If you’re in Berkeley or the East Bay Area and need a professional hand with your cabinet installation, don't hesitate to reach out to Frasheski Construction. We're here to ensure your kitchen remodel is handled with care and expertise.
